fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition and public broadcaster RTB signed an agreement on 21 October 2025 to use AI to make public information accessible, and a live demonstration showed a Moore-French translation tool.

Digital Transition Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane told parliament her department is finalising three major projects: the Djam platform, a chatbot on electronic communications regulation and a chatbot on Burkina Faso's legislative texts.
